content.text: Fixed: `translateMarkdownMisses` in [translation-memory.ts](docs/scripts/translation-memory.ts#L182-L189) only logged progress every 25 files, but guide runs have far fewer markdown misses than that, so nothing printed until the whole locale finished — hence the apparent multi-minute silence. It now logs each file as it's translated (matching the per-chunk progress the batched text/prose workflows already show). Updated the corresponding test in [translation-memory.test.ts](docs/scripts/translation-memory.test.ts#L202-L211) and confirmed the full test file passes.
